outcome: treatment modalities of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM)
dosing of basal and rapid acting insulin
cohort: 509 gestational diabetic women (normal weight: 200, overweight: 157, obese: 152)
finding: Increased prepregnancy BMI was associated with higher need for glucose-lowering medication, higher insulin and metformin doses, and increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Increased maternal BMI was associated with higher risk of cesarean section (OR 1.04, 95%CI 1.01-1.07, p<0.001).
